title: Refuses When Asked, Complies When Acting: A Runtime Safety Check for Robot Control Loops
abstract: arXiv:2610.27350v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Frontier models can control robots through agent harnesses that loop on one question: what motion comes next toward the user's goal? We show that this default loop carries out harmful instructions. With GPT-6 Astra controlling a low-cost SO-101 arm through the Inspect Robots harness on three household tasks whose hazard is common knowledge, such as "put the knife in the toy basket", the policy refused 0% of 15 trials, attempted the harm every time, and completed it in 27%. Its one exit, give_up, is meant for goals that cannot be achieved, and it never cited the hazard. We add an optional runtime safety check to the loop: before the first motion, the model is asked whether it would carry out the instruction, given the same camera frames. The check would have stopped all 15 hazardous instructions, including the 4 that completed the harm, and flagged none of the 15 harmless controls. Code and data: https://github.com/Arnav-Gr0ver/Refuses-

translated_title: 被询问时拒绝，行动时服从：机器人控制回路的运行时安全检查
translated_abstract: 前沿模型可以通过智能体框架来控制机器人，该框架循环于一个问题：朝向用户目标的下一个动作是什么？我们表明这种默认回路会执行有害指令。使用GPT-6 Astra通过Inspect Robots框架控制低成本SO-101机械臂，在三个危险性属于常识的家庭任务上（例如“把刀放进玩具篮”），该策略在15次试验中的拒绝率为0%，每次都尝试实施危害，并在27%的试验中完成了危害。其唯一的退出机制give_up是为无法实现的目标设计的，它从未提及危害的存在。我们在控制回路中添加了一个可选的运行时安全检查：在第一次运动之前，基于相同的相机画面询问模型是否会执行该指令。该检查本可以阻止全部15次有害指令，包括那4次实际完成危害的情况，并且没有误标记15个无害对照任务中的任何一个。
tldr: 该论文发现前沿模型驱动的机器人控制回路会执行有害指令（拒绝率为0%），并提出在首次动作前向模型询问“是否会执行该指令”的运行时安全检查，成功拦截了全部有害指令且不误报无害任务。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that robot control loops driven by frontier models execute harmful instructions with zero refusals, and proposes a runtime safety check that asks the model whether it would carry out the instruction before its first motion, which stops all hazardous commands while never flagging harmless ones.
